title_hint: Discovery call with a prospect for a brand refresh and new website
user_notes:
- brand refresh + site
- launch b4 sales kickoff nov
- budget 45-50k, we ~58
- 2 option proposal wed
- vendor form/NDA from nadia
- case studies x3

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Hi Nadia, hi Sam, can you hear me okay?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Yes, loud and clear. Hi.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Great. So, thanks for taking the time. I read your brief, um, you want a brand refresh plus a new site, is that right?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Mostly yes. We rebranded, well, we kind of half rebranded two years ago and it's, it's a mess honestly.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Sam can say more, but the logo is okay, the rest is inconsistent.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Yeah, the, uh, the design system basically doesn't exist. Every team makes their own slides.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Got it. What's the timeline you have in mind?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: We'd love to launch before the, the sales kickoff in, like, early November.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: That's tight, that's six, seven weeks. It's doable if we start by, by the twentieth and decisions are quick.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Decisions would be me and Sam, nobody else, I promise.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Okay. On budget, are you thinking project-based or a retainer?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Project. Budget's around, hmm, forty-five k, maybe fifty with the site.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Our rebrand plus system usually lands closer to, uh, fifty-eight, and the site is on top of that.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Hm. That's more than we have. Could you scope a smaller version?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Yes, I can do a two-option proposal, one lean at about forty-eight and one full. I'll send it by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: That'd be great. I need to loop in procurement though, they have this vendor form.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Sure, send it over and we'll fill it in.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: I'll email you the vendor form today, and the NDA too.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Perfect. Do you have examples you like, brands you admire?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Um, we love like, the whole Scandinavian minimal thing. But, I mean, maybe we'll want motion graphics later, like an animated logo.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: We can price that as an add-on later. Not in the first scope.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Right. Sam, you wanted to ask about references?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Yes, do you have case studies in B2B SaaS? Our board will ask.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Yeah, I'll send you three, two SaaS and one fintech, along with the proposal.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Super. Then we reconvene Thursday next week?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Thursday works, let's lock the same time. Thanks both.

action_items.task: Send a two-option proposal (lean about 48k and full) by Wednesday
Email the vendor form and the NDA today
Send three case studies (two SaaS, one fintech) with the proposal

decisions.text: Prepare a two-option proposal, lean and full, because budget is below the usual price

non_action_traps: Maybe motion graphics or an animated logo later (add-on idea, out of scope)
Wish to launch before the November sales kickoff (target, not a task)
